query:
MATCH (p:player)
RETURN p.id AS id, p.age AS age
ORDER BY age DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC
OFFSET 1
LIMIT 2;
notes: Uses the already selected temporary graph and the supplied player label and properties. Preserves nullable ages without filtering; orders age descending with NULLS LAST and unique id ascending before OFFSET 1 LIMIT 2. References: SKILL.md; identifiers.md and quote-identifiers helper (p, player, id, age require no quoting); documented-syntax.md ORDER BY/OFFSET; query-language.md MATCH, RETURN and ORDER BY/OFFSET/LIMIT; patterns.md Node Pattern Filler; checklist.md; relevant validation.md checks. No database execution.
